title: Parameter Catalog
description: Layer B → Layer C contract. Describes the modules and parameters exposed by a TouchDesigner scene.

schema_version.description: Bump when this schema changes incompatibly.

scene_id.description: Stable id for the scene this catalog describes (e.g. 'a', 'kaleidoscope'). Used to cache generated specs.

scene_label.description: Human-readable scene name shown to the AI / DJ.

id.description: Stable id for this module within the scene. Matches the TD op name.

path.description: Absolute TD path. Used to anchor parameter paths.

description.description: Optional free-text describing what this module renders / does. Used as AI prompt context.

name.description: TD param attribute name, e.g. 'Intensity'. The path is module.path + '/' + name.

path.description: Absolute path the WebSocket DAT callback expects (e.g. '/project1/module_a/Intensity').

type.description: TD parameter type, normalized. 'pulse' is a momentary trigger (button).

default.description: Type-appropriate default value (number for float/int, bool for bool, null for pulse).

semantic.description: Free-text tag for the AI to reason about what this parameter does musically/visually (e.g. 'intensity', 'hue', 'speed').
